overall: The AG found the notice topic 'Executive session if needed' was not sufficiently specific, but held no violation because the Board did not hold the executive session, and only reminded the Board of its notice obligations.

allegations.summary: The Jan. 22, 2013 meeting notice listed only 'Executive session if needed' as a topic, without stating an executive session purpose.
allegations.key_passage: We therefore find no violation of the Open Meeting Law, but remind the Board of its obligation to list all anticipated topics with sufficient specificity in its meeting notices.
